ravi (PM): Short sync: finalize Observe launch acceptance criteria today. Focus tiles: dashboards (error-by-model/route), tracing hooks (sampling + redaction), cost attribution, error analytics drilldowns. Owners + gates please.

emily (Eng): Main engineering risk is trace write amplification on bursty errors. Need write buffering and a graceful degrade path.

omar (SRE): On load test we saw trace queue spike. Propose auto-throttle: when trace_queue > 3k => reduce sampling to baseline 0.1% and page.

hannah (Eng-Platform): Redaction note: add tenant-level redact allowlist. We'll expose REDACT_RULES env for canary. Example: REDACT_RULES=["email","account_id"].

kai (Solutions): Customers asked for per-tenant 24h cost and a CSV export. Also want an "error cluster" widget showing top stack frames.

emily (Eng): Sampling policy draft: error=100%, success=adaptive (tiers), global cap=150 traces/min/region. Runtime will enforce via token-bucket.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 08:10 PT -> 10% traffic.

ravi (PM): Acceptance gates for moving to 50%:
- dashboards: tiles present and refresh within 3m
- tracing: sampling policy enforced and redaction unit tests passing (FinCust vectors)
- perf: p95 console latency <= 620ms during canary
- cost: rolling-2h cost delta < 11% vs baseline
- ops: trace backlog < 3k and write latency < 350ms

omar (SRE): I'll run 30m synthetic with injected errors and monitor CPU, queue, and auto-throttle behavior. Fail if any threshold breached.

hannah (Eng-Platform): I'll wire cost_emitter events and the /costs/export endpoint. Sharing PR link in thread when ready.

kai (Solutions): I'll prepare customer opt-in wording and FinCust approval checklist. Need final sign-off before 50%.

emily (Eng): Action items: emily=runtime limiter + degrade, hannah=redact + cost export, omar=synthetic validation, ravi=dashboard gating board. ETA: EOD.

ravi (PM): Good. Post perf dashboards and canary logs here when live. We'll treat this as the canonical launch checklist for Observe. :rocket:
